name: walle architecture topology

nodes.cli: cmd/walle: CLI entry, daemon lifecycle, ps and attach
nodes.tui: internal/tui: Bubble Tea client, renders daemon events
nodes.unix: ~/.walle/run/supervisor.sock: Unix Socket + NDJSON default local transport
nodes.http: localhost HTTP JSON: list/open/snapshot/input/stop short requests
nodes.ws: localhost WebSocket JSON: interactive attached stream
nodes.sse: localhost SSE: readonly event stream fallback
nodes.daemon: internal/daemon: Runtime registry, control protocol, provider/auth, event fanout

optional_http_gateway.security: loopback by default, bearer/query token, Origin check

forbidden: no daemon semantics in the public Runtime SDK
no client connects directly to internal/runtime
no non-loopback HTTP listener unless explicitly allowed
no token/API key/account id in logs or session/report
